name: Network Security Controls
description: Deploy firewall and router configs to protect cardholder data environments.

compliant_if.detail: Network rules confirm firewall protection is in place.

partial_if.detail: Network rules exist but deny rules are missing.

missing_if.detail: No network rules to verify firewall protection.

remediation: Deploy and document firewall rules protecting the cardholder data environment.

name: Network Segmentation
description: Verify network segmentation isolates cardholder data environment.

partial_if.detail: Network rules present but no segmentation evidence.

missing_if.detail: No network rules to verify segmentation.

remediation: Implement network segmentation with default-deny between CDE and other networks.

name: No Overly Permissive Rules
description: Verify no ANY/wildcard rules exist in firewall configs.

compliant_if.detail: Network rules contain no overly permissive entries.

partial_if.detail: Network rules exist but contain permissive rules.

remediation: Remove all ANY/wildcard rules. Apply least-privilege to all firewall entries.

name: Protect Stored Cardholder Data
description: Implement controls for stored cardholder data protection.

compliant_if.detail: Governance and asset records confirm data protection controls.

missing_if.detail: No evidence of stored data protection.

remediation: Implement data encryption, masking, and retention policies for stored cardholder data.

name: Encrypt Transmission of CHD
description: Encrypt cardholder data during transmission over open networks.

compliant_if.detail: Network and governance records confirm transmission encryption.

remediation: Use TLS 1.2+ for all CHD transmissions over open networks.

name: Anti-Malware
description: Deploy anti-malware solutions on all applicable systems.

compliant_if.detail: Asset inventory confirms systems are tracked for anti-malware.

missing_if.detail: No asset inventory for anti-malware verification.

remediation: Deploy and maintain anti-malware on all systems commonly affected by malware.

name: Restrict Access to CHD
description: Restrict access to cardholder data by business need-to-know.

compliant_if.detail: Employee records confirm access level tracking.

partial_if.detail: Employees tracked but access review incomplete.

missing_if.detail: No employee records to verify access restrictions.

remediation: Implement role-based access control. Restrict CHD access to need-to-know only.

name: Identify Users and Authenticate Access
description: Assign unique IDs and strong authentication for all system access.

compliant_if.detail: Employee records confirm unique ID assignment.

partial_if.detail: Employee records exist but authentication policy not documented.

missing_if.detail: No employee records for authentication verification.

remediation: Assign unique IDs to all users. Implement MFA for all CDE access.

name: Log and Monitor All Access
description: Enable logging for all access to network resources and CHD.

compliant_if.detail: Governance records confirm logging and monitoring processes.

partial_if.detail: Governance exists but monitoring review not tracked.

missing_if.detail: No evidence of logging and monitoring.

remediation: Enable centralized audit logging. Implement daily log review processes.

name: Information Security Policy
description: Maintain a security policy addressing all PCI DSS requirements.

compliant_if.detail: Governance records confirm security policy exists.

partial_if.detail: Risk register exists but formal policy not documented.

remediation: Establish an information security policy addressing all PCI DSS requirements.

name: Third-Party Service Provider Management
description: Manage service providers with access to CHD.

compliant_if.detail: Vendor records confirm service provider tracking.

partial_if.detail: Vendors tracked but compliance status incomplete.

missing_if.detail: No vendor records for service provider management.

remediation: Maintain a list of all service providers. Require PCI compliance from each.

name: Incident Response Plan
description: Implement and test an incident response plan.

compliant_if.detail: Governance records confirm incident response plan.

partial_if.detail: Risk register exists but no formal incident plan.

remediation: Develop and test an incident response plan covering cardholder data breaches.
